name: Golden Tulip Shanghai Hong Qiao
detail: It was truly a place where I experienced proper 4-star hotel service. Many other places that claim to be 4-star often feel more like 2-star, which can be disappointing, but here the atmosphere, room conditions, and service were overall very satisfying. The room was tidy and well-maintained, and the bedding was so comfortable that it was great for a good rest. The bathroom was also clean and well-kept, so I was satisfied throughout my stay. The staff's responses were friendly and attentive, allowing me to have a pleasant experience during my time there. Above all, what I found most satisfying was being able to stay at a hotel of this quality for such a price, and if I go to Shanghai again, it’s a place I would want to visit without hesitation.
area: New Hongqiao Commercial Center and Changning,Shanghai - View on map

name: UrCove by Hyatt Shanghai on the Bund
detail: The location is across from the Huangpu River and the Oriental Pearl, and it is close to Yuyuan Garden. The room condition is top-notch in Shanghai (everything, including the bathroom and bed, is new and very nice). The service is excellent. There is a pleasant scent in the hallways, likely because it is a newly built place. However, it is somewhat far from the heavily visited Nanjing East Road, so please keep that in mind.
area: The Bund and North Bund,Shanghai - View on map

name: Shanghai Fish Inn East Nanjing Road
detail: The room condition is much better than expected. It is very spacious, the bed is large, and when you pull back the curtains, sunlight comes in. It's a non-smoking room, so there's no smell of cigarettes at all, and the cleaning staff were very friendly. The location is very close to the center, allowing for a morning run along the Huangpu River, while still being in a quiet alley, which is nice. However, there are two Fish N' locations nearby, so you need to be careful when ordering delivery or taking a taxi. Lastly, there is occasionally a cat on the first floor that is very, very fat and cute. That alone is worth a perfect score.
area: The Bund and North Bund,Shanghai - View on map

name: Okura Garden Hotel
detail: This was my second stay this year. I made a reservation because the overall advantages outweighed my curiosity to try other hotels. The cleaning was thorough, and the amenities were abundant. The water quality and pressure were good, the bath was spacious, and in addition to the solid feel of the building, the staff provided a sense of stability, making me feel at ease when returning from outings. I was looking forward to the buffet-style breakfast after swimming in the pool. The hotel is located almost in the center of Shanghai, close to a subway station, and it coexists with both the latest brand buildings and local shops, making for pleasant walks on the premises. Additionally, since it is in the former French Concession area, exploring the surroundings was also enjoyable. I was very satisfied to be able to stay at such a high-quality hotel at a special rate.
area: Xintiandi and Huaihai Rd,Shanghai - View on map

name: Oriental Riverside Bund View Hotel
detail: It was a lovely hotel that exuded a sense of luxury and high prestige. The lobby was beautifully designed, and the open space, which could be viewed from the glass elevator, left a strong impression. Additionally, the walls were adorned with photographs of notable figures like Mr. Kissinger, Mr. Xi Jinping, and Mr. Putin, creating an international and prestigious atmosphere. The room was very clean, featuring a separate bathtub and shower room, and was well-equipped with amenities, allowing for a comfortable stay. Above all, what stood out most was the warm and kind service from the staff. Everyone was genuinely friendly and attentive, making me feel very happy and comfortable during my stay. While the hotel’s facilities and ambiance were certainly wonderful, it was the kindness of the staff that particularly impressed me. If I have the chance to visit Shanghai again, I would definitely like to stay at this hotel once more.
area: Lujiazui and New Int'l Expo Center Pudong,Shanghai - View on map

name: City Hotel
detail: When I first checked in at the reception, the staff was very unfriendly, but afterwards, I felt a warmth from the other employees I interacted with, like the cleaning staff. I was satisfied with the breakfast and it was great to have a gym so I could maintain my routine while traveling! The location was also convenient for catching taxis to go anywhere, and while the facilities weren't extremely clean, hot water came out well, it was cozy, and the city view was nice. I would love to stay here again next time!!
area: Xintiandi and Huaihai Rd,Shanghai - View on map

name: Hi Cozy Youth Hostel East Nanjing Road & The Bund
detail: I usually don't write reviews, but the staff was so kind and the satisfaction level was high that I felt compelled to write one. I had a great time during my 4-night, 5-day stay. ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ An accommodation with such incredible accessibility at this price? It would be a loss not to go there... I stayed in a twin room with a friend. The bunk bed is high, but the ceiling is also high, so it doesn't feel cramped and you can sit on the bed without hitting your head (those who have stayed in hostels will know how important this is). It's a bit difficult to open two suitcases at the same time, but you can easily open and organize one. You can privately close the bed with blinds, and there are USB and Type-C charging ports at each spot, so you don't need to bring an adapter. There's a space to put a large bag next to your head. All necessary functions are efficiently included in the small room, making it a really well-designed hostel. The bathroom has both a toilet, sink, and shower booth with both a rain shower and a hose. The water pressure is good, and hot water comes out instantly. There are shampoo, conditioner, and body wash available. There's also a space to hang clothes in the bathroom, making it convenient. Towels are free. They clean the room daily and even provide clean linens, which you can also receive from the front desk. The common area is spacious and clean. Even if you're alone, there are many foreigners, so it's a great place to make friends! There’s a water dispenser and a refrigerator. It seems to be open 24 hours? I worked the night shift and it was comfortable. There's also an outdoor workout space and a laundry room. The best thing was the staff!!!! ❤️🎀 Lris, Mia, and Nico were so cute, kind, and it really amazed me how much they were willing to help... I couldn't order delivery because of Meituan being down, but they ordered for me using their phones... They showed me directions... They even helped find misplaced deliveries... They were just angels 😇🪽❤️ Thanks to these friends, I was able to have a very comfortable stay. I highly recommend it!!
area: People Square and South Bund Huangpu,Shanghai - View on map

name: Artyzen Habitat Hongqiao Shanghai
detail: It is close to Hongqiao Airport and within a 10-minute walk to Koreatown. There are nearby shopping malls, and it was safe to move around in the evening. Karry Wang staff were kind and able to communicate in Korean, which was a great help.
area: Hongqiao Airport and National Convention Center,Shanghai - View on map

name: A.T.HOUSE Jiadi Hotel Shanghai Xujiahui
detail: Although it is close from the exit of the Xujiahui Station, you have to walk quite a distance through the underground pathway, so it may not be suited for tourists. However, it was a hotel with quality that more than makes up for that, so I highly recommend it for those who are familiar with Shanghai.
area: Xuhui and Minhang,Shanghai - View on map

name: Jinglai Hotel (the Bund East Nanjing Road)
detail: The walkability was excellent, and it was conveniently connected to the airport, making travel easy. The hot water was good, the Wi-Fi was stable, and the clean environment made for a comfortable stay. The staff were very friendly and even ordered delivery for us. It is a satisfying value-for-money hotel.
